{{Quote|May I help you?''"<br />"''We know where we're going.''"<br />"''You know where you are going.|Master Sinube performs a mind trick on the attendant|audio=SinubeMindTrick-LL.flac|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
This [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''attendant''' at the desk of the [[Spider Arms Hostel/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel]] in [[Slum district G17/Legends|slum district G17]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]].

==Biography==
When [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] lost her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to a pickpocket, she and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] tracked the thief to the Spider Arms Hostel. When they entered the establishment, the attendant looked at the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with suspicion from behind the desk and asked if he could help them. Master Sinube used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to bypass the wary Rodian and continue with their investigation.
